reasons: The cited clauses (Sections 26–27) select California law with exclusive venue in California state or federal courts, which squarely meets the playbook fallback (Delaware or California law and courts) and is therefore correctly classified as compliant.
No arbitration provision exists, so the walk-away scenario (foreign venue or arbitration seated abroad) is not triggered; the rationale states this accurately.

Consistent with the claimed compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the original text is left unchanged — appropriate, since upgrading an acceptable fallback to the preferred New York position would be over-flagging.
Sub-preferred features (California over New York; venue narrowed to the Vendor's local county) are properly noted in the rationale rather than raised as a deviation.
Deterministic check confirms the governing law falls within the accepted set.
